senses.gloss: m. (ταμιακός, tamiacus) belonging to the imperial treasury, tamiaca (praedia), crown-lands, imperial domains. Esth. R. introd. אתם ט׳ אתם you are crown property (God’s own people); הלוקח לו עבד מן הט׳ שוב וכ׳ (read של בשר ודם, abbr. של ב״ו, for שוב) does not he who takes to himself a slave from the crown lands forfeit his life? Ib. (ref. to Esth. VIII, 7) על דפשט ידיה בט׳ because he stretched forth his hand against crown property (the Jews).
